mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing clonazepam plasma concentrations and CNS depression risk; additive sedation may occur.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, dizziness, or cognitive impairment; consider spacing doses or reducing clonazepam dose if CNS effects emerge; counsel patient on avoiding concurrent high-dose turmeric supplements.
